representativeSnapshot.kind: organization with active and inactive staff, invited and confirmed event assignments, published packets, bulletins, and team communications

rowCountQueries: Count team communications by event and tour scope, including rows with null org_id
Count confirmed and active employment assignments by canonical event and organization
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Existing event- or tour-scoped communications receive only derivable organization IDs; unscoped historical rows remain null

execution.resumeStrategy: Re-run the additive migration; columns and indexes are guarded, policy replacements are deterministic, and the backfill touches only null organization scopes
execution.idempotency: Schema additions and indexes use if-not-exists, policy replacements drop before create, and the backfill updates only null org_id rows

quarantine.strategy: Do not guess organization ownership for historical communications without an event or tour; leave them unscoped and unavailable to worker overview reads

constraints: worker reads require recipient or accepted assignment ownership
indexes: team communications organization and sent time
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Apply to an isolated snapshot, verify recipient and cross-user RLS personas, inspect query plans for recipient/reminder reads, and smoke the worker overview and event workspace

recovery.rollback: Disable the overview communications reads and restore the prior named policies only through a reviewed forward migration; retain additive columns and data
recovery.forwardFix: Correct policy predicates or indexes additively and replay the null-only organization backfill

queries: Inspect RLS policies for team_communications, event_bulletins, events_v2, venues_v2, organizations, tasks, and work_mode_publications
Verify a confirmed worker can read assigned event content and a cross-user worker receives zero rows
Verify reminder recipient and remind_at indexes are used for bounded reads
